motivation: EXP-I is explicitly a three-reviewer convergence experiment. The pre-execution claim gate validated reviewer_id presence but did not require exactly three distinct reviewer identities, allowing duplicated reviewer records to potentially manufacture apparent unanimity when no dissenting record was present.
new_invariant: Claim-bound convergence requires exactly three review claims from exactly three distinct non-empty reviewer_id values for the same case before reviewer consensus can become eligible for independent verification.
new_falsification_vectors: one reviewer duplicated three times cannot manufacture consensus
two distinct reviewers with one duplicated record cannot manufacture three-reviewer consensus
four or more reviewer records do not silently alter the frozen three-reviewer decision contract
allowed_resolution: Fail closed as INVALID_REVIEW_INPUT for any reviewer-cardinality or reviewer-identity-distinctness violation.
unchanged_rules: exact primary-class and exact artifact-scope agreement are required
unanimity without independent verification is insufficient
verification must be platform-issued, valid, and bind exact case/class/scope
